statement: Every-PR Linux shader compilation and path-gated llvmpipe scene tooling are registered. The scene catalogue pins material, tree-impostor cutout, night-sky and terrain-blend references with per-reference origins, source identities, full-image MAE/p99 thresholds and independent cutout, stellar horizon/radial and terrain coverage invariants. Bounded sky/terrain shader replays ran under llvmpipe; native scene target execution remains pending. Dusk azimuth continuity is measured without an accepted baseline, with its proposed threshold pending issue #918. TAAU sharpening bounds one shared RGB adjustment to the current neighborhood, preserving channel ratios at channel-specific bounds; registered CPU regressions cover brightening, darkening, zero and signed channels, HDR, flat bounds and channel permutations. The existing software-GL terrain scene also exercises the production sharpening helper; native issue #871 re-capture remains pending.

evidence.planned: Run the registered opt-in material, tree-impostor, night, dusk and terrain scene target under llvmpipe; owner: maintainers
